0022600196.text: Philadelphia (8-2, 1st in the Atlantic and 1st in the East) enters its 11th game of the season on a one-game losing streak, while Chicago (1-7, 4th in the Central and 14th in the East) is on a six-game losing streak. Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery) and Dominick Barlow (back, fracture) are out for the 76ers, and Adem Bona is day-to-day with a back sprain and is a game-time decision. For the Bulls, Nic Claxton (hamstring strain) is out, while Jalen Smith (hand) and Zach Collins (illness) are day-to-day and game-time decisions. Philadelphia beat Chicago 126-107 in Philadelphia on November 2, 2026, its only meeting so far this season, and the 76ers lost 1-2 to the Bulls in 2025-26.
